title: Delete removes a different note than the one you clicked
why: Something does get deleted, just not visibly. The targeted note stays put, and the deleted one was off-screen.
finding: The store's `deleteNote` ran with id `3111cdbd`. The clicked row was `845761ce`, which stayed in the list with `aria-selected="true"`.
actual: The note "Sample content for the new note." (id 845761ce) remains in the sidebar (still marked aria-selected="true") and its content stays in the editor. The store's deleteNote ran and removed a DIFFERENT note (id 3111cdbd, not visible near the top or bottom of the list), leaving the targeted note untouched.
expected: Clicking the Delete control on a note row should remove that specific note from the sidebar list; since it was the selected note, the editor should transition to the empty "No note selected" state.

chronology.text: After creating a new note and typing 'Sample content for the new note.' into it, the journey clicked that note's Delete control in the notes sidebar (Playwright step 273: locator.click on the button matching 'aside > div:nth-of-type(2) > div:nth-of-type(45) > div:nth-of-type(1) > button' at coordinates (243.25, 544.25), step time 163240ms).

chronology.text: The note 'Sample content for the new note.' is still listed in the sidebar (row data-key='845761ce', aria-selected='true') and the editor pane header and body still display 'Sample content for the new note.' — the targeted note was not removed and the editor did not switch to the 'No note selected' empty state.

The stale note persists to the end of the recording (over 5 minutes after the Delete click): the note item is still present in the sidebar (its text node sits at y = -1606 px in a 720-px viewport, scrolled out of view), and the editor pane still displays the note's title and content with no error or empty state.

reproduce.text: Navigate to the collaborative AI editor app
Fill in the display name field with a test name
Click the New note button to create a new note
Type sample content into the editor surface of the newly created note
Delete the currently selected note by clicking its delete button in the toolbar

rootCause.text: The sidebar note-item Delete control's onPress handler passes a stale/mismatched note id to the store's deleteNote action: the Logpoint instrumentation on the deleteNote body captured the call with deleteId '3111cdbd' while the button clicked was the one rendered for note '845761ce' (title 'Sample content for the new note.'). The loop inside deleteNote matched and removed the entry with id '3111cdbd' (t.notes.delete(f, 1) executed with notesLen 48), so a different note was deleted while the targeted note stayed in the list and remained selected in the editor. The DOM confirms the outcome: the row with data-key='845761ce' / aria-label 'Sample content for the new note.' is still present with aria-selected='true', and no row with key '3111cdbd' exists anywhere in the list.
